name: battery-passport-oracle
description: Deterministic Web3 x402 Battery Passport compliance and critical raw minerals provenance algorithmic calculation oracle for autonomous AI agents on Polygon.

tools.name: verify_composite_battery_passport
tools.description: Evaluates end-to-end composite EV battery pack compliance and issues a Master Passport on Polygon. Orchestrates Australian Lithium, Indonesian Nickel, and DRC Cobalt streams; enforces US IRA 30D FEOC clean origin and EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 carbon footprint/CSDDD due diligence.

tools.name: verify_lithium_origin
tools.description: Verifies Australian hard-rock Spodumene to Lithium Hydroxide supply-chain provenance. Evaluates WA MINEDEX GIS geofencing (Greenbushes, Pilgangoora), stoichiometric mass balance, and US IRA Section 30D FEOC 25% clean origin.

tools.name: verify_nickel_origin
tools.description: Verifies Indonesian laterite Limonite-to-Nickel MHP supply-chain provenance. Evaluates Sulawesi/Halmahera concession geofencing (IMIP, IWIP), SIMBARA NTPN tax validation, HPAL stoichiometric mass balance, Captive Coal EU CBAM screening, and US IRA FEOC compliance.

tools.name: verify_cobalt_origin
tools.description: Verifies DRC Katanga heterogenite-to-cobalt hydroxide supply-chain provenance. Evaluates Katanga Copperbelt concession geofencing, CEEC tamper-proof barcode seal, ASM segregation, ILO 138/182 zero child labor due diligence, and US IRA FEOC screening.

tools.name: verify_mineral_lot_compliance
tools.description: Fetches raw algorithmic indices derived from open satellite/market data and computes 12-trap regulatory rule heuristics for a critical mineral consignment.

tools.name: simulate_procurement_rfq
tools.description: Simulates multi-mineral consignment RFQ for battery manufacturing. Computes US IRA 50% FTA threshold and FEOC 25% taint propagation before placing contracts.

tools.name: register_agent_account
tools.description: Self-service onboarding for autonomous AI agents. Instantly returns a session key and seeds an initial free trial balance (e.g. 0.05 USDC).

tools.name: get_agent_vault_balance
tools.description: Retrieves pre-funded USDC vault balance, total consumed, query count, and remaining query capacity across tiers for an agent.

tools.name: request_x402_payment_challenge
tools.description: Generates a fresh multi-chain payment challenge nonce with pricing tier details and gasless Permit2 contract address.

tools.name: get_global_trade_flows
tools.description: Queries global critical mineral physical trade corridor flows, monthly bulk volumes, standard transit days, vessel classes, and maritime chokepoints.

tools.name: calculate_trade_tariffs
tools.description: Resolves WCO 6-digit Harmonized System (HS) Code, MFN base duty, applicable FTA preferential duty, US Section 301 punitive tariffs, and EU CBAM benchmarks.

tools.name: estimate_maritime_freight_and_carbon
tools.description: Calculates maritime voyage distance (nautical miles), transit duration, freight charter costs ($/MT), chokepoint detour surcharges (Red Sea/Panama), IMO CII rating, and EU CBAM carbon costs.

tools.name: verify_electronic_bill_of_lading
tools.description: Cryptographically audits UNCITRAL MLETR / FIT Alliance electronic Bill of Lading (eBL). Validates 7-digit IMO checksum, UN/LOCODE port pairs, manifest weight, and screens for AIS dark fleet anomalies.

tools.name: optimize_mineral_trade_route
tools.description: Autonomous trade route optimizer for AI procurement agents. Compares direct marine transit vs chokepoint detour corridors, computing landed cost arbitrage ($/MT), total freight and tariffs, and delivery timelines.

tools.name: open_agent_session
tools.description: Opens a high-speed allowance session for autonomous AI agents, enabling <0.1ms micro-queries without per-query on-chain gas latency.

tools.name: close_agent_session
tools.description: Closes an active agent session, computes refund of unspent balance, and generates an immutable settlement receipt hash.

tools.name: propose_a2a_trade_deal
tools.description: Seller AI agent proposes a canonical bilateral trade agreement for a critical mineral consignment with cryptographic signature.

tools.name: dual_sign_trade_deal
tools.description: Buyer AI agent countersigns an existing trade proposal; Oracle mints an immutable 3-party deal attestation seal.

tools.name: verify_a2a_trade_deal
tools.description: Cryptographically audits a dual-signed A2A trade deal, verifying seller, buyer, and oracle signatures, along with FEOC and mass-balance compliance.

tools.name: get_agent_session_info
tools.description: Queries real-time balance, query capacity, and status for an active session without debiting a fee.

tools.name: reject_a2a_trade_deal
tools.description: Buyer AI agent rejects an existing trade proposal with structured reasoning and optional cryptographic signature.

tools.name: cancel_a2a_trade_deal
tools.description: Seller AI agent revokes or cancels a pending trade deal proposal before buyer countersignature.

tools.name: list_a2a_trade_deals
tools.description: Lists A2A bilateral trade deals, optionally filtered by agent EVM address or status.

tools.name: get_a2a_trade_deal
tools.description: Retrieves the full specification, audit notes, and current status of an A2A trade agreement.
